content:
9P&10P

作者的话：
With kind permission of:Sergio Contreras & FODS Records, Fonográfica del Sur S.L.I made this painting for a project about Cluster Headache.
我绘制的这张画主要是关于丛发性头痛这样一种病状， 关于该病状介绍的网站。→→en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cluster_headache

I was contacted ***Al.ce Cluster Europe 
我联系到了欧洲AL.ce这个群体（官网如↓）
www.cefalea.it/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&catid... for cooperate in their art gallery about this disease.
帮他们艺术画廊画了这张主题为丛发性头痛的画。

The coordinator, Claudio Geraci, of this association asked me some paintings for him on the topic, the first painting was the burden, this is the pain.
The music is quite different from my normal choose, but it was specifically asked for the video and working on it, has become part of the painting.
这种音乐风格完全和我以往选择的背景音乐不同，因为他们有专门要求用这个音乐来做这个视频的背景音乐，所以我也木有办法了，不过我还有上传另外一个相同的视频，只是音乐背景是符合我平常音乐风格的！希望大家喜欢…………

content:
5P

作者的话：
I made this painting for the 1000Drawings project, it's a one night exhibition for charity in Amsterdam, on May the 11th. There will be 1000 drawings for sale for the same low, accessible price (€10).. this is my partecipation to the event. So, I hope that someone among you will find my little watercolor and buy it!

Proceeds will be donated to support FairPen, which helps children in Uganda to run an editorial office with their peers, investigate issues, think critically, and publish handwritten, handdrawn newspapers to each other and to their local communities.
